<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Umbral gnome scouts patrol the tunnels that lead into their settlements.

<column gap="tiny">

([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 15

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Umbral Gnome Scout](/NPCs.aspx?ID=3021)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Gnome" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=617" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 172

**Perception** +7; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Gnomish](/Languages.aspx?ID=5), [Sakvroth](/Languages.aspx?ID=118)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +7, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +5, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +7, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +5

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +2

**Dex** +4

**Con** +2

**Int** +0

**Wis** +2

**Cha** -1
</row>

**Items**
[Light Pick](/Weapons.aspx?ID=30), [Sling](/Weapons.aspx?ID=72) (20 bullets)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 17 

**Fort** +7 

**Ref** +9 

**Will** +5 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 18

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
light pick +7 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [fatal d8](/Traits.aspx?ID=178)),
**Damage** 1d4+2 piercing

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
sling +9 ([Propulsive](/Traits.aspx?ID=191), [range increment 50 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [reload 1](/Traits.aspx?ID=254)),
**Damage** 1d6+1 bludgeoning

**Primal Innate Spells** DC 14
- **1st**
[Illusory Disguise](/Spells.aspx?ID=159)

**Hidden Movement**   If the umbral gnome scout starts their turn [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=96) or [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=79) to a creature, that creature is [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) against the umbral gnome scout's attacks until the end of the turn.

</column>
